name: Indexer
tip: An indexer answers 'where can I find npub X'. It hands out addresses and stores no one else's posts — a phone book, not a library.

children.name: volunteer
children.label: Volunteer this device
children.tip: Off = hold nothing. Plugged in = serve while on a charger and a real uplink. Always = serve regardless. Revoking is exactly as easy as granting.

children.name: topics
children.label: Topics I index (comma separated)
children.tip: What you are comfortable indexing. Leave empty to index everything this device hears (wide); name topics to serve only those.

children.name: maint
children.tip: Maintenance. Every tile says exactly what it would remove; tapping it runs exactly that.
